purpose: Gate priority-engine runtime work to an explicitly authorized, pinned disposable save whose actual bytes pass the canonical exact save/game version classifier. Save-role classification and version compatibility remain separate authorities.
allowedScope: read disposable-save policy, registry, and active pin
read the pinned save bytes through the canonical save-compatibility classifier
reject a pinned save unless its role and exact version are automation eligible
invoke the canonical launcher lifecycle without force-stopping an ambiguous or human-owned runtime
dispatch priority-engine work against the exact approved disposable save
write gitignored classification and runtime result artifacts
forbiddenScope: mutate any save that is not the approved disposable pin
treat filename, calendar year, or registry cohort as version proof
force-stop an active or ambiguously owned Bannerlord session
claim observed priority-engine behavior from command dispatch alone
promote launcher or command acknowledgement into trade/runtime proof
proofBoundary: The workflow may reach live-runtime proof only when same-run behavior evidence proves the priority-engine outcome. Exact save classification, launcher success, and command dispatch are lower proof levels and must remain ATTENTION/BLOCKED until that behavior evidence exists.
